rationale: Identity: the held original (70 FR 12961, Mar. 14, 2005) is Executive Order 13374, Amendments to Executive Order 12293. I read the whole held text. Section 1 replaces section 4 of EO 12293, section 2 strikes and inserts agency titles in section 2 of EO 12293, section 3 revokes EO 13325, and section 4 is a no-rights clause. Each command is self-executing and complete on issue, and the order sets no deferred date or duration. The 22 U.S.C. 3901 note lists 13374 only as an amender of EO 12293; that shows the amended text living in the parent and does not show this order in force. Provisional no is supported.
